propositions: Three detached-spawn sites independently re-implement the same PYTHONPATH bootstrap, detach flags, and stdio discipline, creating a maintainability seam where defects (like missing cwd=) propagate by imitation across multiple tickets and sites.
A fourth copy-paste site appeared in gc_trigger.py during review, demonstrating that the duplication pattern continues to manifest without a single authoritative implementation.
Consolidating all detached-rebar-child spawning into one helper (rebar._proc.spawn_detached) eliminates the replication vector and ensures platform flags and bootstrap logic are correct once.

The helper must remain a stdlib-only leaf with no rebar.* imports; callers retain their own env construction (secret-stripping, sync flags) and exception handling (OSError vs broad Exception), so consolidation does not change exception surface or env semantics.

A static source scan test must enforce that the detached spawn signature tokens (DETACHED_PROCESS, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, sys.path.insert re-entry stub) appear only in _proc.py, catching future copy-paste sites at gate rather than runtime.
